lightningLessons.title: How to break into API Product Management
lightningLessons.courseName: API Fundamentals for Product Managers
lightningLessons.description:
API Product Management is more technical, more challenging, and higher-stakes than a “core” PM role. It also offers distinct rewards: deep technical mastery, greater autonomy, and higher compensation.
Today, I’m sharing my secrets on how to break into API PM that I Iearned over 15 years as an executive so you can fast-track your own API career.

outcomes.title: What Is API Product Management and Why It’s Worth Pursuing
outcomes.description: Understand how API PM differs from traditional PM roles—and why it pays off.

outcomes.title: Where to Find an API Product Management Job
outcomes.description: Discover which industries and companies need API PMs, and learn how to network with them.

outcomes.title: How to Prepare for the API Product Manager Interview
outcomes.description: Learn what hiring managers expect so you can stand out and secure the offer.

outcomes.title: How to Upskill for the API PM Role
outcomes.description: Identify gaps in your technical or market knowledge, then build a plan to fill them.

lightningLessons.title: Leverage AI to Drive Better API Product Decisions
lightningLessons.courseName: API Fundamentals for Product Managers
lightningLessons.description: You’ll discover how AI-powered API analytics transforms you from a reactive PM into a strategic leader. You’ll see how Moesif’s dashboards help you identify patterns, predict developer needs, and prove your product's business impact. You’ll learn how successful API PMs use these tools to make confident decisions, elevate their careers, and become indispensable to their organizations.

outcomes.title: Visualize Your API Developer's Journey
outcomes.description: Discover how to map and analyze the complete customer journey from signup to paid conversion.

outcomes.title: Spot Conversion Roadblocks
outcomes.description: Learn exactly where and why developers abandon your API funnel, enabling targeted improvements to boost adoption.

outcomes.title: Make Data-Driven API Decisions
outcomes.description: See how AI insights can guide feature prioritization and help you measure the impact of API changes on business metrics.

outcomes.title: Customize Analytics Without Code
outcomes.description: Tailor Moesif dashboards to your  API product needs without requiring technical expertise or engineering support.

lightningLessons.title: Build Your Own API Prototype in 20 Minutes with AI
lightningLessons.courseName: API Product Mastery for Experienced PMs
lightningLessons.description:
At the end of this hands-on session, you’ll have an API prototype that you can:
 1) Show to customers for discovery, validation and feedback.
 2) Use to pitch a new product idea internally
 3) Create concrete product specification as part of your product requirements 
4) Unblock Front-End teams so they can start building while a back-end team implements the API

outcomes.title: Quickly create accurate OpenAPI specifications using LLMs
outcomes.description: Leverage AI to generate precise API specifications efficiently.

outcomes.title: Easily verify your API design and quality against standards
outcomes.description: Use free validation and rating tools to ensure your API design complies with industry standards and best practices.

outcomes.title: Deploy and render a fully documented mock API
outcomes.description: Implement a mock API complete with comprehensive documentation for immediate customer interaction.

lightningLessons.title: Create AI-Powered API Documentation Fast
lightningLessons.courseName: API Product Mastery for Experienced PMs
lightningLessons.description:
Great documentation makes APIs usable, discoverable, and trustworthy. Yet, crafting high-quality docs manually is slow and error-prone.
By automating your docs creation using AI, you’ll ship faster, reduce mistakes, and enhance developer satisfaction.
Learn these practical skills and elevate your impact as an API Product Manager—delivering clear value quickly.

outcomes.title: Build Your API Docs Quickly
outcomes.description: Use Theneo to rapidly generate clear, professional documentation from any OpenAPI spec—yours or a sample provided

outcomes.title: Enhance Docs with AI Features
outcomes.description: Incorporate advanced tools like AI-powered search, interactive "try-it-out" and automated changelogs.

outcomes.title: Automate Writing Tasks
outcomes.description: Leverage AI to eliminate tedious, repetitive writing, freeing you to focus on clarity and quality.

outcomes.title: Integrate into Your Workflow
outcomes.description: Understand how to smoothly add AI-driven documentation tools into your PM and development cycles.

lightningLessons.title: Develop, Deploy and Secure Your API with AI Codegen
lightningLessons.courseName: API Product Mastery for Experienced PMs
lightningLessons.description:
In this hands-on session, we'll explore using AI tools to speed up API delivery while maintaining quality and consistency.
As an IC PM, you are more powerful than you think. Once you’ve validated an API spec with customers, you'll use it to build a server with Replit and deploy it behind a Gateway on Zuplo.
You're now more than an API PM—you are a builder taking an API from idea to realization.

outcomes.title: Build Your API with AI Code Generation
outcomes.description: You'll learn how to use AI-generated code to rapidly build your API's first version from validated specifications.

outcomes.title: Test Your API Implementation Effectively
outcomes.description: You'll see how you can test scenarios efficiently to confirm your API works as expected and meets your customers’ needs.

outcomes.title: Deploy and Secure Your API
outcomes.description: You'll deploy the API behind a cloud API gateway to protect it, while keeping alignment with the original requirements.

outcomes.title: Evolve your technical PM skills
outcomes.description: You'll understand how to take an API Product from concept to production, expanding your impact as a Product Manager.

lightningLessons.title: AI Agents are Coming for Your API - Are You Ready?
lightningLessons.courseName: API Product Mastery for Experienced PMs
lightningLessons.description:
AI Agents will soon dominate API consumption. And if they can’t easily access your API, they’ll scrape your website or, worse, use a competitor’s API. For an API Product Manager, that’s a scary thought.
Using real-world examples, we’ll present practical actions you can take to future-proof your APIs, embrace the incoming agent wave, and turn disruption into a competitive advantage.

outcomes.title: Identify AI Agent Integration Challenges
outcomes.description: Recognize common issues AI agents face when connecting with current APIs.

outcomes.title: Understand How LLMs consume APIs
outcomes.description: Learn how Large Language Models interact with APIs using tools such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).

outcomes.title: Assess Your API’s Readiness for AI Agents
outcomes.description: Use a checklist to evaluate gaps in your APIs so you can prepare and prioritize what to address.

outcomes.title: Create a Plan to Prepare Your APIs for AI Agents
outcomes.description: Develop actionable steps to make your APIs compatible with AI agents.

lightningLessons.title: Build AI-Ready APIs with MCP
lightningLessons.courseName: API Product Mastery for Experienced PMs
lightningLessons.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become a key topic among API providers and consumers. MCP lets AI agents and Large Language Models (LLMs) access APIs, introducing a new category of consumers for API providers. It presents significant opportunities for those who adopt it. In this lesson, we’ll explore what API Product Managers need to know about MCP and how to incorporate it into their roadmaps.

outcomes.title: Recognize MCP’s Importance for API Providers
outcomes.description: Identify how Model Context Protocol enhances API integration with AI Agents & LLMs.

outcomes.title: Discover the Current State of MCP
outcomes.description: Examine the latest developments and applications of MCP in the industry.

outcomes.title: Generate an MCP Server from OpenAPI Specs
outcomes.description: Learn to create an MCP server using your existing OpenAPI specifications.

outcomes.title: Incorporate MCP into Your API Roadmap
outcomes.description: Define steps to integrate MCP into your API development plans.

lightningLessons.title: Hands-On MCP: From API to Live MCP Server in Minutes
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description:
Only trust MCP servers from the owner of a resource.
Publish your own MCP server for your APIs urgently, before someone else steps in!
If you want to get started publishing an MCP server, we'll show you how to get started quickly, so you avoid the potential of someone else to poison or man-in-the-middle Agent access to your API.
This will be a hands-on session, where you'll deploy your MCP server!

outcomes.title: Generate an MCP server from your OpenAPI
outcomes.description: Instantly transform your existing APIs into MCP servers - no coding needed.

outcomes.title: Test your MCP tools locally on Claude
outcomes.description: Quickly validate your MCP integrations with live AI-agent tests on Claude.

outcomes.title: Deploy to an MCP Registry to make it available to the world!
outcomes.description: Easily publish your MCP server publicly, expanding your API’s reach.

outcomes.title: Plan for Next Steps
outcomes.description: We'll take your questions and talk about where to learn more about MCP and securing your MCP servers.

outcomes.title: Session sponsored by AI Collective
outcomes.description:
The AI Collective is a non-profit, grassroots community exploring the frontier of AI. 
NOTE: We'll use Roam, not Zoom!

lightningLessons.title: 12 Things Every API Product Needs to Be Agent-Ready
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description:
Agents aren’t coming—they’re already here, transforming how APIs are consumed and integrated. Your next API consumers aren’t just developers but AI-driven agents demanding clarity and simplicity. Are your APIs agent-ready?

This Lightning Lesson introduces 12 actionable approaches to help API PMs, Engineers, and Architects lead in agent-driven ecosystems.

outcomes.title: Define Your 2026 API Roadmap
outcomes.description: 80% of your API Product Roadmap should be getting ready for AI/Agents. Learn the 12 essentials you need to cover.

outcomes.title: Understand How To Get Started with MCP
outcomes.description: Model Context Protocol lets Agents and LLMs "see" your APIs. Find out why you need to get started today.

outcomes.title: Prioritize Design Changes to Your API Product
outcomes.description: MCP lets Agents "see" your APIs. We'll explore what you need to do to optimize them so that they are actually usable.

outcomes.title: Prepare Your Infrastructure for AI Agents
outcomes.description: You'll determine the improvements you need to make to embrace the incoming agent wave and embrace new opportunities.

lightningLessons.title: Agent Impact: From Chaos to Clarity
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description:
Ever felt buried under endless feedback, requests, or bug reports?
You’ll discover how we moved from reactive, issue-by-issue problem solving to a system that can analyze, connect, and prioritize thousands of signals at once. Through the story of building our own in-house agent, you’ll see how AI can act as a teammate, summarizing, cross-referencing, and even suggesting immediate solutions.

outcomes.title: Identify the (large) problem
outcomes.description: In our case, solving issues one-by-one slowed progress. Shifting to graph-level analysis unlocked scale.

outcomes.title: How an AI agent can synthesize thousands of issues
outcomes.description: Generate actionable insights from all you issues, feature requests and use comments.

outcomes.title: Integrating an agent into Slack
outcomes.description: Give everyone in your organization instant, citation-backed access to community knowledge.

outcomes.title: Quantify the outcome
outcomes.description: Save time for product managers, designers, and engineers, freeing them to focus on building rather than just reading.

lightningLessons.title: Use AI To Build Your AI Product
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description:
Speakeasy is a platform for creating, curating, and hosting MCP servers.

The company uses AI behind the scenes to build, test, support & document new AI developer products, serving as the ground zero for understanding how LLMs can accelerate both product development and operations.

You'll learn from real-world examples, not theory.

outcomes.title: Changing the way you build with AI
outcomes.description: Curate MCP servers for day-to-day work in Revops, GTM, Customer Support, Documentation and Analytics.

outcomes.title: Prompt versioning
outcomes.description: Bake prompts into your product and understand their lifecycle.

outcomes.title: Eval testing
outcomes.description: Ensure customer experience with AI dev tools remains high-quality.

outcomes.title: Safe rollout of LLM-based features
outcomes.description: Prevent hallucinations and model changes from affecting your product.

lightningLessons.title: Build Your Own AI-Powered API for n8n
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description:
Retail teams lose hours every week manually classifying products across different marketplace taxonomies. This means slower launches, inconsistent data, and missed revenue.
With today’s AI tools and APIs, this problem can be solved in days, not months. This session shows how to use LLMs and lightweight frameworks to automate categorization at scale, with human guardrails for quality and control.

outcomes.title: How to turn a ChatGPT prototype into a production-ready API
outcomes.description: See how an idea tested in a chat window evolved into a fully deployed Flask API with OpenAPI docs.

outcomes.title: Design AI-Powered APIs that blend reasoning and rules
outcomes.description: Learn how to balance LLM flexibility with deterministic logic for predictable, auditable results

outcomes.title: Build and Orchestrate AI Workflows
outcomes.description: Explore tools such as n8n, ChatGPT, Claude, and marketplace APIs work together to automate publishing across platforms.

outcomes.title: Test and Evaluate AI APIs in production
outcomes.description: Understand practical methods for creating automated evals, tracking accuracy, and managing model drift and rate limits.

outcomes.title: Lessons from Building an AI API for Marketplace Taxonomies
outcomes.description: Take away real work insights on managing API governance, cost control, and reliability while shipping quickly.

lightningLessons.title: Fix Your Broken API Process
lightningLessons.courseName: API Product Mastery for Experienced PMs
lightningLessons.description: Inconsistent APIs slow teams down and frustrate users. This live 45-minute workshop is built for PMs, Engineers, and Architects who ship APIs every day. You’ll score your own API process with our 20-point checklist, see where to improve, and leave with a clear plan to deliver faster, safer, AI-ready APIs.

outcomes.title: Score your API process live with a 20-point checklist
outcomes.description: Evaluate your delivery flow step-by-step and find the biggest blockers to API consistency and speed.

outcomes.title: Discover what “good” looks like for real API teams
outcomes.description: See how top organizations structure governance that actually accelerates development.

outcomes.title: Align PMs, Engineers, and Architects around one process
outcomes.description: Turn messy handoffs into smooth collaboration using shared API lifecycle rules.

outcomes.title: Make your APIs consistent, secure, and AI-ready
outcomes.description: Understand how strong governance prepares your APIs for agents, automation, and scale.

outcomes.title: Leave with your own API improvement plan
outcomes.description: Walk away knowing your score, your next prioritized actions, and a template to start improving tomorrow.

lightningLessons.title: Land Your Next Technical Product Manager Job With AI
lightningLessons.courseName: API Product Mastery for Experienced PMs
lightningLessons.description:
Having interviewed hundreds of applicants between us, we'll uncover the key areas you need to focus on:  The difference between people who get coveted roles in AI and other technical areas and those who don’t isn’t
talent - it’s demonstrated experience, proof, and a helpful network. So stop chasing jobs and start proving value. Replace “spray & pray" with “learn & show”.

outcomes.title: How to Make the Odds Be in Your Favor
outcomes.description: Learn how to target high-growth companies that are hiring for roles that are in demand.

outcomes.title: Customize to Maximize Your Opportunity
outcomes.description: Tailor your applications and outreach strategy. Leverage referrals, standout resumes, and personal connections.

outcomes.title: Highlight Transferable Skills
outcomes.description:
Personalize your resume to
get more interviews & optimize for Applicant Tracking Systems.

outcomes.title: Be a Fit: Why Similarity Matters
outcomes.description: Employers look for proven experience in similar roles (domain, tech, seniority, complexity) to reduce hiring risk.

outcomes.title: Learn by example
outcomes.description: We'll show you good narrative examples that have worked, from actual applicants' resumes and cover letters.

lightningLessons.title: How to Get Hired at an AI Startup
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description:
Ever wondered what founders really look for when building their team?
Join us for a candid conversation on what it takes to stand out and succeed in the world of AI startups. You’ll get an inside look at how platform and technical product roles are evolving, how founders think about hiring and culture fit, and what skills set apart PMs and engineers who thrive in high-velocity AI companies.

outcomes.title: Understand the Founder Mindset
outcomes.description: Learn how founders evaluate talent & product sense and why some candidates immediately stand out.

outcomes.title: Spot Emerging Roles in AI
outcomes.description: Understand how AI startups redefine the boundaries between Product, Engineering, and Platform roles.

outcomes.title: Position Yourself as a Multiplier
outcomes.description: Discover how to present your experience so founders see you as someone who amplifies team impact, not just fills a role.

outcomes.title: Navigate Early-Stage Environments
outcomes.description: Get strategies for thriving in the ambiguity, speed, and experimentation that define successful AI startups.

outcomes.title: Chart Your Career Path
outcomes.description: Walk away with practical frameworks for deciding whether to join, lead, or found in the AI startup ecosystem.

lightningLessons.title: Publish Your First MCP Server Today
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description: AI agents need access to your APIs and data. Model Context Protocol (MCP) is the open standard that makes this possible, and it just turned one year old. Learn why major companies are adopting MCP, understand the latest spec updates, and publish your first working server. Whether you're building agents or evaluating MCP for your team, this session gives you what you need to start.

outcomes.title: Understand the Model Context Protocol specification
outcomes.description: Learn what's in the 2025-11-25 spec release and how MCP enables AI agents to safely access your API tools and data.

outcomes.title: Publish your first MCP server in minutes
outcomes.description: Follow along as we build and publish a working MCP server that lets LLMs and agents discover and "see" your APIs.

outcomes.title: Connect and test MCP servers with agents
outcomes.description: Connect your MCP server to Claude and other tools that help you test and debug it.

outcomes.title: Understand security risks when exposing APIs to AI
outcomes.description: Learn common security pitfalls and basic precautions to consider when connecting agents to your systems.

lightningLessons.title: The Double Life of the API Product Manager
lightningLessons.courseName: API Fundamentals for Product Managers
lightningLessons.description:
APIs are everywhere, and with AI and Agents, API Products are more in demand than ever.
But most PMs don't know how to approach them.
So, breaking into Product Management can be tough, but with 15+ years as an API PM lead, I can help you make the transition smoothly.
Also, becoming more technical and specialized has its rewards: Platform and API PMs get paid more than core PMs, > 19% on average!

outcomes.title: Why so few PMs know APIs & MCP well & how you can join them
outcomes.description: APIs are a technical discipline and your customers are developers, so you have to be able to speak their language.

outcomes.title: Why API PM is 2x challenging but also super rewarding
outcomes.description: Your product is powering solutions you might never have imagined. As a result you'll work harder and be irreplaceable.

outcomes.title: Top 5 ways to do API PM really well (that most people miss)
outcomes.description: I'll show you the 5 in-demand skills needed, on top of your regular PM know-how. (hint: AI and specs feature heavily).

outcomes.title: What the top API-as-a-Product companies do differently
outcomes.description: Organizations like Stripe, Twilio & OpenAI rely heavily on the API Product Management discipline, hiring top candidates.

outcomes.title: How to become more technical as a PM in 2026
outcomes.description: Build your plan to learn more and practice the skills needed to become a more technical PM.

lightningLessons.title: Design a Public API Product from Scratch
lightningLessons.courseName: API Fundamentals for Product Managers
lightningLessons.description: A public API turns your product into a platform. It reduces churn as users build your product into their workflows, whether they code, or use tools like Zapier. In 30 minutes, I'll show you how to go from raw user feedback to an API design. We'll come up with an API for Maven students like you as our example. Bring your own use case or follow along.  You'll leave with a process you can repeat.

outcomes.title: Collect & Organize Developers' API Requirements
outcomes.description: We'll take data and ideas collected from existing users and use AI to organize into patterns & use cases you can act on.

outcomes.title: Break Down Use Cases into Automation Outcomes
outcomes.description: Translate what users' needs into specific API endpoints and payloads they can use, including useful error messages.

outcomes.title: Generate an API Design as a Hypothesis
outcomes.description: You'll use my prompts to generate a blueprint for an API, using your context and market insights.

outcomes.title: Get Ready to Validate the API with Real Users
outcomes.description: Once you have a solid design, we show you how to validate it against standards and how to get feedback from your users.

lightningLessons.title: Design a Partner API That Drives Revenue
lightningLessons.courseName: API Product Mastery for Experienced PMs
lightningLessons.description: Partner APIs help platforms grow by empowering the people who drive their revenue. In 30 minutes, I'll show you how to turn market insights into a real API design. We'll use Maven as our example, designing an API that helps instructors like me work efficiently while delivering a great student experience. You'll see how to identify partner needs, prioritize by impact, and produce a testable spec.

outcomes.title: Map Partner Workflows to Platform Capabilities
outcomes.description: Understand how partners work today and which platform features can be used to power their automations.

outcomes.title: Synthesize Requirements and Prioritize by Revenue Impact
outcomes.description: Not all features matter equally. We'll learn how to rank API capabilities by what drives partner success.

outcomes.title: Generate an API Design & Spec to Gather User Feedback.
outcomes.description: Walk away with a standards-based OpenAPI spec you can use as a prototype & share with real users for validation.

outcomes.title: Design for AI Agents from Day One
outcomes.description: Build in support for AI agents and MCP so your API is ready for how partners will work tomorrow.

lightningLessons.title: Upgrade Your API Design with AI
lightningLessons.courseName: API Product Mastery for Experienced PMs
lightningLessons.description: "Rushing to code" with GenAI creates technical debt. To build production-grade APIs, you need a structured approach. James Higginbotham (LaunchAny) joins us to demonstrate the ADDR process: a methodology that turns LLMs into "API Design Coaches". You will learn to cut design time by 60% while delivering high-quality, business-aligned, and AI-ready APIs.

outcomes.title: Learn a Structured API Design Method
outcomes.description: We walk you through a complete, annotated design session using the ADDR process (Align, Define, Design, Refine)

outcomes.title: Experience a Real API Design Session
outcomes.description: Walk through of an actual API design session that includes prompting tips, guardrails, and example outputs.

outcomes.title: Choose Your Own AI API Design Tools
outcomes.description: Select an LLM model that best fits your needs and is trained to solve API design challenges.

outcomes.title: Cut API Design Time by 60%
outcomes.description: Use AI to generate job stories, profiles, and OpenAPI specs in minutes.

outcomes.title: Generate Production-Ready Specs
outcomes.description: Auto-generate high-fidelity OpenAPI 3.1 specs and README documentation that align with your style guide.

lightningLessons.title: Master MCP Essentials for PMs
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description: MCP is emerging as the standard way AI apps connect to real tools and data, like APIs for agents. For PMs, it unlocks connected ChatGPT experiences and a path to store-ready apps, while reducing one-off integrations. In this lesson, you’ll learn what MCP is, where the spec is today, and how to try it in ChatGPT. You'll understand the state of the MCP spec and potential pitfalls to look out for.

outcomes.title: Explain MCP in plain PM language
outcomes.description: Understand clients/servers, tools/resources, and how MCP lets agents and LLMs "see" your data.

outcomes.title: Spot product bets MCP unlocks
outcomes.description: Map MCP to agents and connected apps, API strategy, and what it enables for ChatGPT experiences and Store-ready apps.

outcomes.title: Assess spec maturity and risks
outcomes.description: Know what’s stable vs evolving, plus auth, security, and how governance is shaping the protocol.

outcomes.title: Try MCP inside an LLM (hands-on)
outcomes.description: Add a remote MCP server, and run a few tool calls end-to-end, so you can brainstorm product ideas for the future.

outcomes.title: Where to find the best next resources
outcomes.description: Leave with the key docs, links, resources, and communities to follow as MCP evolves in 2026.

lightningLessons.title: Create MCP Tool Evals Before You Ship
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description: MCP makes LLM apps powerful, but one wrong tool call can break flows, waste tokens, or return bad data. Tool evals measure task success, catch selection mistakes early, and detect drift as APIs and data change. We'll learn how to set up a repeatable eval harness with MCPJam to improve reliability now and monitor regressions as you ship updates.

outcomes.title: Understand tool calls and failure modes
outcomes.description: Learn how LLMs select MCP tools, what drives success rate, and common routing failures.

outcomes.title: Set up MCPJam with a sample MCP server
outcomes.description: Install MCPJam, connect to a remote MCP server, and verify tool calls end-to-end.

outcomes.title: Build a repeatable tools eval harness
outcomes.description: Add sample prompts + assertions to validate tool selection and outputs for key user requests.

outcomes.title: Run evals and collect data
outcomes.description: Execute the harness, read pass/fail results, and diagnose tool mismatches.

outcomes.title: Next Steps: Operationalize evals to prevent drift
outcomes.description: How to scale your workflow by with the MCPJam CLI and CI, collect real user prompts, and re-run as APIs and data evolve.

lightningLessons.title: Build an MCP Server for ChatGPT Apps
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT Store is becoming the new distribution channel for products. To get listed, you need two layers: a Web UI component and an MCP server that lets ChatGPT call data tools. PMs and engineers who can turn an existing API into a hosted MCP server (low/no-code) can prototype store-ready apps fast, validate demand, and ship products to take advantage of this emerging opportunity.

outcomes.title: Map ChatGPT Store requirements
outcomes.description: Understand the two main parts (Web component + MCP server) and what the Store will evaluate.

outcomes.title: Generate a hosted MCP server
outcomes.description: Use your existing API to generate tools and host a remote MCP server in under 20 minutes.

outcomes.title: Connect MCP to a simple Web component
outcomes.description: Wire the server to a minimal UI and test end-to-end tool calls.

outcomes.title: Submit with a practical checklist
outcomes.description: Know what to document, test, and package before you submit to the ChatGPT Store.

lightningLessons.title: Design ChatGPT Apps Worth Building
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description: ChatGPT Apps let third parties extend what ChatGPT can do, but they're not for every product or feature. Before getting started, you need to know what makes a great app, what works inside a conversation, and how to spot ideas that won't fit. This lesson gives Product Managers and business leaders the foundations to evaluate opportunities and ask the right questions.

outcomes.title: Understand what a ChatGPT App actually is
outcomes.description: Choose a set of capabilities the model calls mid-conversation, not a replica of your existing product.

outcomes.title: Recognize good-fit vs. poor-fit use cases
outcomes.description: Use OpenAI's "Know, Do, Show" framework and discuss real examples.

outcomes.title: Ask the right scoping questions to ensure success
outcomes.description: Before you build an app: Does it need conversation? Can it complete in-chat? Is it something ChatGPT can't already do?

outcomes.title: Know the three display modes for ChatGPT Apps
outcomes.description: OpenAI recommends inline cards, carousels, and fullscreen - we'll discuss when each makes sense for your use case.

lightningLessons.title: Get Your ChatGPT App Approved by OpenAI
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description: OpenAI reviews every ChatGPT App before it goes live. Many submissions get rejected for avoidable reasons. This lesson gives PMs and business leaders an overview of the process, the platform constraints that affect what you can build, and the pitfalls that delay approval. You'll leave knowing what to expect and what to ask your dev team to take advantage of this new distribution opportunity

outcomes.title: Know what goes into a ChatGPT App submission
outcomes.description: What’s a good app name, tool descriptions, privacy policy, test account, verified organization, logos and screenshots.

outcomes.title: Recognize the common rejection reasons so you can flag risks
outcomes.description: Avoid vague tool descriptions, requesting unnecessary data or misleading metadata.

outcomes.title: Understand the current platform constraints
outcomes.description: Today, you can only sell physical goods, no ads, restricted to a general audience (13+), limited data you can collect.

outcomes.title: Map out a realistic timeline from idea to published app
outcomes.description: Including what gets locked after approval and when you'd need to re-submit.

lightningLessons.title: Why Agents Can't Use Your Product
lightningLessons.courseName: What Agents Want from Your Product
lightningLessons.description: Software has transitioned from clicks and taps to chatting with AI. There is another major change coming: people will start delegating tasks they want done to agents. Agents want outcomes, and the products that win will be the ones that give them the easiest path to those outcomes. In this session, you'll learn how agents use APIs and what stops them in their tracks, so you can fix them.

outcomes.title: Why your product is hard for agents to use
outcomes.description: Agents are smart but they also seek the quickest cheapest path to an outcome. We'll show you where they fail.

outcomes.title: Four things agents want and one they don't
outcomes.description: Ideally you'll have one or more ways for agents to use tools and not have to scrape pages. We'll show what to use when.

outcomes.title: How to check if your APIs are usable by agents
outcomes.description: We'll show you how to come up with a list of prompts and desired/undesired outcomes so you can test your own product.

outcomes.title: The top changes to make your APIs friendlier to agents
outcomes.description: You'll take away a high-level plan and a 12-point checklist so you can get started towards agent-friendly API products.

lightningLessons.title: The Easiest Way to Prototype an API
lightningLessons.courseName: Build an API-First Product with AI
lightningLessons.description: Most API products launch without real customer validation. Teams spend months building, only to find out users wanted something different. A working prototype changes that. In 30 minutes, you'll see how to go from idea to a prototype your customers can actually try, and how to use their feedback to build the right thing the first time.

outcomes.title: Why customer validation is important for API products
outcomes.description: Your idea is just a hypothesis that you need to validate with actual customers "outside the building". APIs included.

outcomes.title: How to build an API MVP the right way
outcomes.description: Learn the right way to build prototypes and MVPs, proven by 15+ years of experience and made easy with AI tools.

outcomes.title: Generating your first prototype in minutes
outcomes.description: A high-quality API Spec lets you generate mock API with functional endpoints and documentation you can give to users.

outcomes.title: How to gather and use customer feedback for API products
outcomes.description: You'll take away the tools to compile your feedback into Spec changes, ready for building your API product.

lightningLessons.title: Why Your Product Needs MCP
lightningLessons.courseName: Build an MCP Product with AI
lightningLessons.description: Everyone is talking about MCP but most teams have never seen a server from the inside. If your product doesn't have one, agents can't connect to it. In 30 minutes, you'll explore a working MCP server, use it live in Claude, and inspect how its tools work. Then we'll show you it was built with no code. You'll leave knowing what it takes to add MCP to your own product.

outcomes.title: Know when to use MCP vs APIs, CLIs, and Skills
outcomes.description: Four ways agents access your product. MCP is the only one that works on every surface. Know when & where each one fits.

outcomes.title: What's inside an MCP server & why it matters
outcomes.description: Understand what Tools, Resources & Prompts are used for and how Descriptions affect Agent UX.

outcomes.title: How to add MCP to an AI tool and use it
outcomes.description: Add a server to Claude, run tasks, and see how the agent picks the right tools in real time.

outcomes.title: What's it like to build MCP for your product
outcomes.description: How to build your own MCP servers with no-code: tools available to you.

lightningLessons.title: Build for ChatGPT's New App Store
lightningLessons.courseName: Build a ChatGPT App with AI
lightningLessons.description: ChatGPT has 900M weekly users and a new app directory with only 390 apps in it. That's a huge opportunity. But most teams don't know what a ChatGPT App even is, let alone how to build one. In 30 minutes, you'll tour the ecosystem, use real apps, see one I built with no-code, and learn OpenAI's framework for what makes a good app. You'll leave knowing whether this channel is right for your product.

outcomes.title: Why you're early to the ChatGPT Apps opportunity
outcomes.description: 900M users, a growing directory, and almost nothing in it yet. We'll show you what's out there and what's missing.

outcomes.title: What's a ChatGPT App and where to find one
outcomes.description: Explore the OpenAI directory, Install an app, run it live and understand what experiences are possible.

outcomes.title: What makes a good ChatGPT App
outcomes.description: What are the best use cases. Which ones are bad. Not every product fits. Know if yours does.

outcomes.title: How a ChatGPT App gets built with no code
outcomes.description: Know what tools are available, including no-code and how to start building and validating good ideas.

lightningLessons.title: Agent Skills and Why Your Product Needs Them
lightningLessons.courseName: Build & Ship Agent Skills for Your Product
lightningLessons.description: Skills go beyond simple Markdown files that automate tasks. They can stand on their own as knowledge & process distribution for your organization. They add intelligence to your other developer tools, such as APIs, SDKs, CLI, and MCP, for use as tutorials, documentation, and even onboarding. This session teaches you a framework for evaluating where Skills fit in your roadmap and how to build them.

outcomes.title: Where to find & install Skills
outcomes.description: Which directories have the best, secure Skills that you can use in AI tools.

outcomes.title: What a useful, secure Skill looks like
outcomes.description: Understand the components of a Skill beyond simple Markdown. Know the risks that malicious Skills can introduce.

outcomes.title: Use cases for Skills in your product
outcomes.description: Skills are useful on their own as instructions or documentation as well as to wrap and enhance your developer tools.

outcomes.title: How to build and distribute Skills as part of your product
outcomes.description: Learn the framework to productize and go to market with agent Skills.

lightningLessons.title: Design an API Product with Agent Skills
lightningLessons.courseName: Build an API-First Product with AI
lightningLessons.description:
Can we make AI do API Design for us? Reliably? Like the best architect on the team?
I built a Claude Code Skill just for that.
It generates a complete API spec and lints it automatically for quality. You stay in the loop where it matters: the design decisions. AI handles the 1000-line JSON file nobody wants to type.
In this session, I'll show you how it works and we'll run it together, hands-on.

outcomes.title: Build a complete, standards-based API design in 30 minutes
outcomes.description: We'll take you from an idea to a complete, highly usable API spec ready for prototyping or building.

outcomes.title: Install and use the API Design Skill in Claude Code
outcomes.description: Complete process: User Stories→API Spec→Hill Climb to a high score→Preview Swagger Docs.

outcomes.title: Understand how markdown context files work for high quality
outcomes.description: Dive into the 4 markdown files you'll use as input: Requirements, Domain Model, API Standards, OpenAPI best practices.

outcomes.title: Learn the importance of hill-climbing to get higher quality
outcomes.description: Demonstrate the use of an OpenAPI linter and use the output to iteratively improve API quality up to 100%.

outcomes.title: Take the Skill back to your organization and adapt it
outcomes.description: Distribute it to every PM on your team (yes, agents too) and ensure high quality API design that checks all the boxes.

lightningLessons.title: Extending Claude: Build Plugins & Connectors
lightningLessons.courseName: Build an MCP Product with AI
lightningLessons.description:
Your most engaged customers are in Claude, Cowork and Claude Code. Anthropic has built the protocols (Skills, MCP) and directories where you can submit your products as Plugins and Connectors for discovery and use by millions of your users and prospects.
Learn which use cases are best suited for these extensions and what you need to know to build, submit, and promote them to your audience.

outcomes.title: How Claude users can leverage external tools and extensions
outcomes.description: What add-ons work well and how different user personas benefit from Connectors & Plugins as part of your product.

outcomes.title: MCP & Connectors give access to external data
outcomes.description: How MCP helps bring your product into Claude and how to choose between MCP, APIs, and CLI. Explore top use cases.

outcomes.title: Skills & Plugins automate processes
outcomes.description: Skills can be a core part of your product’s experience and Plugins take them even further. Each belongs on your roadmap.

outcomes.title: Choosing between Anthropic's native & 3rd party directories
outcomes.description: Each offers different distribution advantages. Learn what it takes to submit to each and how to avoid the pitfalls.

lightningLessons.title: Good CLI Design is Agent UX
lightningLessons.courseName: Build AI-Ready API Products With MCP
lightningLessons.description: Command-line tools are the leanest interfaces an agent can use, and every coding agent supports them. Your product probably needs it, but no one talks about CLI UX, even though it's never been more important. There is deep design wisdom dating back to the Unix philosophy, and agents benefit from it all. You'll learn what makes a great CLI, why agents love them, and principles no one else teaches.

outcomes.title: Why agents prefer CLI over other interfaces
outcomes.description: It's not just speed and tokens. Learn what makes CLI the most streamlined interface an agent can use.

outcomes.title: The downsides you need to know about
outcomes.description: CLI isn't right for every product or every agent. Know when it fits and when other interfaces work better.

outcomes.title: What good CLI design looks like
outcomes.description: Tour real CLIs agents love and ones they struggle with. Consistent flags, helpful errors, clean output.

outcomes.title: How to add a CLI to your product
outcomes.description: Where to start with design. What tools are available and how to get started building one for your own product.

lightningLessons.title: Where Do AI-Ready APIs Come From?
lightningLessons.courseName: API Fundamentals for Product Managers
lightningLessons.description: AI makes it easy to generate an API and ship it. It's just as easy to ship the wrong one: unsafe, unusable, or solving no real need. API design authority Mike Amundsen joins me to show where AI-ready APIs come from: stories. You'll learn to turn your requirements into API Stories, hold AI to your standards, and keep the judgment that stops a bad API from reaching your users, human or agent.

outcomes.title: Why your APIs should start with stories, not specs
outcomes.description: Humans work around a wrong API. Agents just fail. Capture the real need before anything ships.

outcomes.title: How to turn requirements into an API Story
outcomes.description: Write the five story parts from requirements you already own, and hand AI something worth building.

outcomes.title: How to hold AI to your company standards
outcomes.description: Generate specs, docs, and prototypes that follow your standards instead of the model's habits.

outcomes.title: Which design decisions you should never delegate
outcomes.description: Anyone can generate an API now. Learn where you stay in the loop so what ships is safe and usable.
